answer_1.quote: AAD-LLM is trained to generate a response sequence O = Cat(CoT, A), combining the CoT prompt and final answer.
answer_1.outputs: response sequence combining chain-of-thought prefix and final answer

answer_2.quote: We further considered four tasks for both the foreground (attended) and background (ignored) speaker or speech, covering different levels of speech and language processing: Speaker Description (acoustic) evaluates the accuracy of identifying the gender (G), pitch (P), and tempo (T) of the target speaker. Speech Transcription (phonetic & syntactic) measures transcription quality using word error rate (WER) and BLEU against the target speaker's actual speech. Speech Summarization (semantic) assesses summary quality with ROUGE-L and METEOR, using three GPT-4o mini (OpenAI, 2024) reference summaries. The highest-scoring reference is reported. Free Q&A (semantic & pragmatic) evaluates responses to questions about the target speech, such as sentiment analysis, fact-checking, and named entity recognition. Three questions and reference answers were generated by GPT-4o mini, with performance measured by ROUGE-L and METEOR.

answer_4.quote: A total of 40 participants were recruited through Prolific to evaluate model-generated answers.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to rate each response on a 5-point scale, where 1 = "Very Poor" and 5 = "Excellent". Responses containing information from the non-target talker were explicitly instructed to be rated poorly.
